title: PCSO donates ChariTimba to PNP Quirino Police Provincial Office

blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO), led by Assistant General Manager for Administrative Sector Julieta Aseo, turned over ChariTimba food packs to Philippine National Police Quirino Police Provincial Office on November 11, 2026, as part of the agency’s Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program. The donated food packs were formally received by Police Colonel Paul Gamido during the turnover ceremony held at the PCSO Main Office along Shaw Boulevard, Mandaluyong City. Gamido expressed his gratitude saying, the ChariTimba units will be distributed to indigenous people, senior citizens and persons with disability (PWDs).
